actors:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production-ready raster sprite atlas for a Russian cartoon match-3 roguelike.
Generate ONE PNG image, EXACTLY 1024 x 1536 pixels, on a genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background, not a white or checkerboard background.
Composition: a mathematically strict invisible grid of 3 equal columns by 4 equal rows, twelve isolated complete character poses, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. All twelve cells have identical dimensions. Generous completely transparent gutters between all cells and at outer edges. Every character, shield, weapon, action arc and effect must be entirely contained inside its own cell, zero overlap or touching other cells. No visible grid, dividers, labels, text or UI.
Style: original clean 2D hand-inked Flash-era cartoon brawler art inspired by the playful energy of Castle Crashers but with entirely original character designs, no exact copyrighted replicas. Thick confident black outlines, very simple flat cel shading, punchy silhouette, oversized boxy helmets, expressive eyes, tiny stocky bodies, black mitten hands and heavy black boots. No pixel art, no realism, no 3D, no texture, no paper grain.
Hero: one consistent blue/cyan heroic knight, boxy steel helmet with cyan face panel and expressive wide eyes, blue tabard, black mittens and boots, large broad steel sword with clear handle firmly gripped by the right hand, substantial chunky blue shield strapped to left arm. Facing RIGHT in every pose. Same armor and proportions in all six hero cells.
Rival: one consistent reddish-brown barbarian, oversized boxy reddish-brown helmet with short dark horns and expressive angry eyes, warm brown tunic and black mittens/boots, a chunky steel axe with thick wooden handle convincingly gripped. Facing LEFT in every pose. Same armor and proportions in all six rival cells.
Exact row-major pose order:
ROW 1: hero idle / hero windup raising sword / hero strike extending sword RIGHT.
ROW 2: hero guard behind shield / hero hurt recoiling / hero death lying collapsed.
ROW 3: rival idle / rival windup raising axe / rival strike extending axe LEFT.
ROW 4: rival guard / rival hurt recoiling / rival death lying collapsed.
Alignment: identical body size across all standing poses; standing feet baseline at 90 percent of each cell height, body centered in cell. Dramatic readable poses while staying inside each cell, reserve room for complete weapons. A sprite body's standing height should be around 58 percent of its cell height, so all weapons have safe margins. Death poses rest at the same baseline. Transparent background must show through everywhere outside the inked figures.
